r=Robot();spec=r.spec();cams=list(spec['cameras']);ncall=0
lo=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['lower']);hi=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['upper'])
def update(o):
 global obs,q,target,goal,ncall
 obs=o;q=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:29]);target=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][58:87]);goal=np.array(o.meta['task']['goal']) if o.meta['task']['goal'] else None
 ncall+=1; o.save('/app/runs/%04d'%ncall)
 for c,im in o.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).resize((960,720)).save('/app/output/view_'+c+'.png')
 print('STATE',ncall,'q',np.round(q,4).tolist(),'task',o.meta['task'],'left',o.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
 return o

def see(seconds=0):return update(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True,seconds=seconds))
def move(a,seconds=1,hold=0,note=''):
 a=np.clip(np.array(a),lo,hi)
 o=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=round(seconds/spec['control_dt'])*spec['control_dt'],cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='frames',note=note)
 update(o)

def point(cam,u,v,depth=None):
 k=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv']);t=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl']);d=float(obs.depth[cam][int(v),int(u)]) if depth is None else depth
 p=np.array([(u-k[0,2])/k[0,0]*d,-(v-k[1,2])/k[1,1]*d,-d]);return t[:3,:3]@p+t[:3,3]
def project(cam,p):

def annotate(cam,pts):
 im=Image.fromarray(obs.last[cam]).resize((960,720));draw=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 for label,p in pts.items():
  uv=project(cam,p)*3;draw.ellipse((uv[0]-5,uv[1]-5,uv[0]+5,uv[1]+5),outline='red',width=2);draw.text(tuple(uv+5),str(label),fill='red')
 im.save('/app/output/annot_'+cam+'.png')
see()
